title: Complete state

construction: Cooling k=2,x0=8. Plot t in [0,.5], x in [0,9]; tangent at (0,8) has slope −16, and its h=.25 endpoint is ( .25,4). Exact endpoint is 8e^−.5≈4.852245. Draw h as horizontal width and the tangent increment −4 as vertical height.

construction: Equilibrium 0, ε=.5, δ=.25, x0=.2. On t∈[0,2], x∈[−.6,.6], compare .2e^−t and .2e^t. Shade ±ε as a light guide region, show the smaller initial δ segment, and mark unstable exit at ln(2.5). Curve beyond upper range gets an arrow. State the stable inequality for all |x0|<δ, not just the pictured start.

construction: Start .25; t∈[0,4], x∈[0,.5]. Draw .25e^−t, .25/sqrt(1+.125t), constant .25, and .25/sqrt(1−.125t). Label exponential return, algebraic return, unchanged, departure. Positive cubic pole at t=8 is stated outside the displayed safe interval.

construction: Construct F(q,p)=(−q+q²,−2p) at zero. Input η=(.1,.1); rate-plane Jη=(−.1,−.2), actual difference=(−.09,−.2), connecting remainder=(.01,0). Both planes use equal units and axes [−.25,.15]. Show remainder squared scaling ||R||≤||η||².

construction: Default a=1, x0=.2 for f=ax−x³. Rate plot x∈[−1.8,1.8], f∈[−8,8]; align root marks and sign arrows on an x phase line below. Fill attracting ±1, open repelling zero; arrows point to correct attractor. Other a values retain axes and exact zero-root multiplicity classification.

construction: Use b horizontally [−.65,.65], equilibria x vertically [−1.5,1.5]; derive branches parametrically b=x³−x. Mark folds ±2/(3sqrt3), solid outer stable and dashed inner unstable branch. Two arrow paths follow opposite quasistatic sweeps and jump after loss of a well. Exact fold jump targets at the threshold are ±2/sqrt3 with the appropriate opposite sign.
